data.revised_prompt: High-quality 3D chibi educational-app avatar icon, single fictional Chinese schoolgirl (age 8–14), centered square composition, head-only focus with a tiny bit of neck and shoulder visible at the very bottom, not a half-body portrait. Face and hair together fill 75%–85% of the square. Front-facing or very slight three-quarter view. Bold silhouette, minimal detail, high contrast, readable at 48px. Clearly a student, not an adult, not a teacher. Natural slightly wavy shoulder-length short hair with full visible outline, eyebrow-length wispy bangs, purple thin hairband. Confident calm expression with a subtle toothy smile. Bright brown eyes. Soft studio lighting, soft matte materials, refined 3D modeling, cute but mature-for-a-child educational style. Bottom edge shows only a small amount of white school uniform collar, no badge, no text. Background must fully cover the entire square edge-to-edge and corner-to-corner, no white border, no transparency, no circular frame, no halo, no scene; use a full solid low-saturation lemon milk yellow background. No hand, no props, no earphones, no headset, no suit, no heavy makeup, no jewelry. The hair and accessories must be easy to distinguish at 48 pixels.
